tagline: Innovate to transform the lives of patients and their families
hero_kpi_rationale: Jazz's growth is driven by recent and upcoming product launches in high-unmet-need rare diseases (Ziihera, Modeyso), making pipeline progression the key value driver rather than traditional pharma metrics.

kpis.description: Revenue primarily comes from rare disease therapies such as Xywav, Epidiolex and Zepzelca. Growth is supported by clinical adoption and international launches.
kpis.signal: Stable growth driven by Xywav and Epidiolex.

kpis.description: The margin reflects a business model focused on rare diseases with a small number of prescribers.
kpis.signal: High margin for an efficient biopharma model.

kpis.explanation: Share of revenue invested in research and development.
kpis.description: Jazz maintains a high level of R&D to develop new therapies in rare diseases.
kpis.signal: Sustained investment in the rare disease pipeline.

kpis.explanation: Margin after cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Products are highly differentiated, enabling premium pricing and strong margins.
kpis.signal: Very high margin typical of specialized biotechs.

kpis.description: Investments are primarily related to commercial and logistics infrastructure.
kpis.signal: Moderate CAPEX, consistent with a biopharma model without heavy manufacturing.

kpis.description: Headcount supports global commercial, R&D and regulatory activities.
kpis.signal: Stable headcount for a targeted commercial model.

kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $0.476B for last fiscal year (FY2018).

kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of -$0.356B for last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.explanation: Sales of the new liver cancer drug.
kpis.description: Ziihera, launched in December 2024 in the United States, generated $150 million in 2025, showing rapid adoption.
kpis.signal: Successful launch in an untreated rare cancer segment.

kpis.explanation: Portion of Xywav sales related to idiopathic hypersomnia.
kpis.description: Since its launch for IH in November 2021, Xywav has been gaining traction with $400M in revenue in 2025. As of year-end 2025, approximately 5,225 IH patients were taking Xywav.
kpis.signal: Rapid growth in the IH indication, still underdiagnosed.

risks.title: High Debt Levels
risks.summary: The company has high debt levels that could impact its flexibility and access to capital.
risks.score_rationale: The company has high debt levels following acquisitions (GW Pharma), which could impact its flexibility and access to capital. The 10-K explicitly highlights risks related to debt servicing. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Liquidity and Debt Service Risks
risks.summary: The company could face liquidity difficulties if unable to generate sufficient cash flow.
risks.score_rationale: The company could face difficulties if unable to generate sufficient cash flow to repay its debts. The ability depends heavily on sales of flagship products. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on Flagship Products
risks.summary: The company is heavily dependent on its flagship products (Xywav, Epidiolex), which could impact its growth.
risks.score_rationale: Growth relies heavily on Xywav and Epidiolex. A loss of market share or regulatory issues could significantly impact growth and profitability. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory Risks and Drug Approvals
risks.summary: The company is subject to strict regulations, which could impact its ability to market its products.
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict FDA and other regulatory authority regulations. Recent launches (Ziihera, Modeyso) are under accelerated or conditional approval, requiring confirmatory studies. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competitive Risks
risks.summary: The company operates in a competitive market, which could impact its growth and profitability.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market. Example: Lumryz (Avadel) launched May 2023 for narcolepsy with high-sodium oxybate, although Xywav retains cardiovascular safety advantages. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Capital Needs for Future Growth
risks.summary: To grow, the company will need to engage in substantial investments that could affect its operational capacity.
risks.score_rationale: To continue growing, Jazz will need to invest substantially in acquisitions, licensing, clinical trials and commercial expansion, which could limit its financial flexibility. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: Jazz Pharmaceuticals does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
